name: Aniruddh Bhilvare
title: Staff Software Engineer
tagline: I help teams design and deliver multi-tenant SaaS backends, AI-assisted engineering workflows, and reliable enterprise platforms.
about: I'm Aniruddh Bhilvare, a Staff Software Engineer focused on SaaS architecture, backend and distributed systems, and Agentic AI. I help teams turn complex product requirements into maintainable systems, cleaner delivery practices, and software that can keep growing after the first release.

I started my career building mobile applications across Android and iOS at Ecosmob, Netrix, and YUJ Designs, including a SIP/VoIP client for enterprise customers and a connected-vehicle app for Citroën. Over the years, my focus shifted toward backend and distributed systems, where I've worked on multi-tenant SaaS platforms, cloud services, and the data models that support them.

At Particle41, I combine enterprise software delivery with AI-assisted engineering workflows, including developer tooling, delivery automation, and practical evaluation loops that help teams move faster without compromising engineering discipline. I've also led teams of up to 8 engineers and helped establish standards for system design, clean architecture, testing, and code review.
